name: A LA DERIVA 3D
shortDescription: Naufraga en alta mar y sobrevive a la balsa: tormentas, tiburones e islas.
description: Un survival en 3D a la deriva: gestiona agua y comida, pesca, afronta tormentas y eventos diarios (tiburones, buques fantasma, motines) y busca tierra firme antes de que el mar te gane.

screenshots.alt: Náufrago sobre su balsa rodeado por el océano y la interfaz de supervivencia
Pantalla inicial y manual de supervivencia de A la Deriva 3D

features: Ciclo día/noche con tormentas, lluvia, niebla y calor
Eventos diarios: tiburones, buque fantasma, motín, ballena
Pesca, gestión de agua y comida, búsqueda de islas

en.shortDescription: Shipwrecked at sea, survive on your raft: storms, sharks and islands.
en.description: A 3D survival game adrift at sea: manage water and food, fish, face storms and daily events (sharks, ghost ships, mutinies) and look for dry land before the sea gets you.

screenshots.alt: Castaway on a raft surrounded by ocean, with the survival HUD
Title screen and survival manual of A la Deriva 3D

features: Day/night cycle with storms, rain, fog and heat
Daily events: sharks, ghost ship, mutiny, whale
Fishing, water and food management, island hunting
